sources.title: Nine Inch Nails - Seed0 | nin.wiki
sources.snippet: seed0 is the name of the Pirate Bay account used by Trent Reznor and the Nine Inch Nails camp in 2006 to experimentally distribute Nine Inch Nails material via BitTorrent, outside the normal record label channels. seed0 is named after the Seed number series for Nine Inch Nails promotional releases.
